transcript: Okay, so the reason I set my rankings like this is based off my preference of where I feel like I'll be more comfortable living in. And I think science and innovation takes the first place, being, I think it's going to be exciting and adventurous, while for a more stable outcome, then we have the institutional utopia, where the rule of law takes place, then inner morality, and that's how it goes to religion. I think why I chose religious utopia last is because we have so many religions and they will all want to enforce their own law which can lead to chaos.
